resources.string: Encrypted local snapshots of new messages received by this client. Telegram messages and update state remain unchanged.
Off by default. When enabled, only chats listed below are archived. Secret, disappearing, one-time and forwarding-protected content is always excluded.
No chats selected. Enabling the switch alone archives nothing.

The smaller limit will be saved and cleanup will immediately remove only automatic cards outside it. Manual Memory cards remain.

These controls affect automatic cards and cache-only imports. Manual Memory cards keep priority and the hard safety ceiling remains 500 cards / 256 MiB. MOROK copies only complete originals already in Telegram’s cache and never starts a media download.

Explicitly copies up to 100 recent messages already present in Telegram’s local cache. It does not request older messages or download media. The same exclusions and selected automatic retention/storage policies apply.
